objectives.description: Create test-update-plan-status.sh with pass/fail/info scaffolding and REPO_ROOT/script resolution
Build mktemp-d scratch fixture tree shaped as specs/{NNN}_{slug}/plans
Cover all cases: M1, M2, M3, trailing annotation, two bracket pairs, well-formed, no-op, unknown status, missing dir/file
Assert pairwise distinctness of M1/M2/M3 stderr
Assert no mutation on every failing case via checksum
chmod +x and run the suite; run run-all.sh

approaches_tried.approach: Deploy new test file via deploy-headless.sh alone (without a manifest.json provides.scripts entry)
approaches_tried.reason: deploy-headless.sh only copies files declared in the extension manifest's provides.scripts list; a new file not listed there is silently never deployed. Fixed by adding 'tests/test-update-plan-status.sh' to agent-system/extensions/core/manifest.json's provides.scripts array, then redeploying.
